title.narrative: FFP Strengthening Capacity in Agriculture, Livelihoods, and Environment (SCALE) Project

description.narrative: (USAID Democracy, Conflict and Humanitarian Assistance (DCHA)): The TOPS LWA provides capacity strengthening support in agriculture, livelihoods and natural resource management (NRM), among other key areas. Building on TOPS' leader award outputs, the TOPS Strengthening Capacity in Agriculture, Livelihoods, and Environment (SCALE) Associate Award, will allow FFP to continue to provide capacity strengthening support to agriculture, NRM and on- and off-farm sustainable livelihoods, while simultaneously stimulating the development of systems that can deliver such support without the ongoing need for FFP financing.
